title: Boss: the bug bounty report
summary: A researcher reports three findings against the shop's checkout and refunds. Reproduce each from the report, then fix it so the proof of concept fails and real customers are unaffected.

steps.title: Report #4471 (triaged: valid, high)
body: Title:    Order discount and refunds can be manipulated; errors leak database credentials
Reporter: a researcher on the shop's bug bounty programme
1. Free orders. The client sends the discount itself:
2. Refunds without limits. When the limits service is slow (I sent large requests to it),
every refund is approved. Refusals are not in the audit log, and a username with a
line break in it writes a fake audit line.
3. GET /reports/2019 returns a developer error page that includes a connection string.

Fix each one in the steps that follow. A good fix makes the proof of concept fail **and** keeps the honest path working: real coupons still apply, refunds within limits still go through, valid reports still load.

steps.title: Finding 1: the discount comes from the coupon, not the client
prompt: - the discount comes **only** from `coupons[order.Coupon]` (codes are case-insensitive: `welcome10` works); `discountPercent` in the body is ignored;
- no coupon means no discount; an unknown coupon gets `400`;
- `qty` must be 1 to 100, else `400`; an unknown sku gets `400`;
- the answer stays `{ "total": ... }`, rounded to 2 decimals.
**Run checks** replays the report's requests and some honest ones.
starter: if (!catalog.TryGetValue(line.Sku, out var price)) return Results.BadRequest();
// The app works out the discount for the coupon and sends it along.
record Order(List<OrderLine> Items, string? Coupon, decimal DiscountPercent);
solution: if (order.Items is null || order.Items.Count == 0) return Results.BadRequest();
if (!catalog.TryGetValue(line.Sku ?? "", out var price)) return Results.BadRequest();
total -= total * percent / 100m;   // our percentage; DiscountPercent from the client is ignored
record Order(List<OrderLine> Items, string? Coupon, decimal DiscountPercent);
template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
static async Task<decimal?> Total(HttpClient http, object body)
var r = await http.PostAsJsonAsync("/checkout", body);
if ((int)r.StatusCode != 200) return null;
return decimal.Parse(DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(r), "total") ?? "0");
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("The checkout could be called", async () =>
var lamp = new[] { new { sku = "LAMP-01", qty = 1 } };
Dojo.Eq("the report's request: discountPercent 100 no longer makes it free", (decimal?)49.00m, await Total(http, new { items = lamp, discountPercent = 100 }));
Dojo.Eq("discountPercent 150 does not make it negative", (decimal?)49.00m, await Total(http, new { items = lamp, discountPercent = 150 }));
Dojo.Eq("coupon WELCOME10 gives 10% off: 44.10", (decimal?)44.10m, await Total(http, new { items = lamp, coupon = "WELCOME10", discountPercent = 90 }));

Dojo.Eq("codes are case-insensitive: winter25 gives 25% off two bulb packs: 18.00", (decimal?)18.00m, await Total(http, new { items = new[] { new { sku = "BULB-04", qty = 2 } }, coupon = "winter25" }));
DojoWeb.Status("an unknown coupon gets 400", 400, await http.PostAsJsonAsync("/checkout", new { items = lamp, coupon = "FREE100" }));
DojoWeb.Status("a negative quantity gets 400", 400, await http.PostAsJsonAsync("/checkout", new { items = new[] { new { sku = "LAMP-01", qty = -1 } } }));
DojoWeb.Status("an unknown sku gets 400", 400, await http.PostAsJsonAsync("/checkout", new { items = new[] { new { sku = "NOPE", qty = 1 } } }));
hints: Make the dictionary case-insensitive: `new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) { ... }`.
`var percent = 0; if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(order.Coupon) && !coupons.TryGetValue(order.Coupon, out percent)) return Results.BadRequest();`, then use `percent` and never `order.DiscountPercent`.

steps.title: Finding 2: refunds fail closed, and every decision is audited
prompt: Write `string ProcessRefund(string user, decimal amount, Func<string, decimal> limitLookup, List<string> audit)`:
- it returns `"approved"` when `0 < amount <= limitLookup(user)`, otherwise `"refused"`;
- if `limitLookup` throws anything, the refund is `"refused"` (fail closed);

- **every** call adds one line to `audit`, refusals too: `user=<v> action=refund-approved target=<amount>` or `action=refund-refused`, with the amount written as `0.00` (`amount.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)`);

- values are encoded as in the STRIDE lesson: plain when only ASCII letters, digits and `._@:/-`; otherwise in double quotes with `\\`, `\"`, `\r`, `\n`, `\t` and `\u00XX` escapes. (The 100-character cut is not needed here.)
starter: string ProcessRefund(string user, decimal amount, Func<string, decimal> limitLookup, List<string> audit)
solution: string ProcessRefund(string user, decimal amount, Func<string, decimal> limitLookup, List<string> audit)
template: {{CODE}}
var log = new List<string>();
Func<string, decimal> limits = u => 100m;
Dojo.Eq("a refund within the limit is approved", "approved", ProcessRefund("sam", 40m, limits, log));
Dojo.Eq("...and audited", "user=sam action=refund-approved target=40.00", log.LastOrDefault());
Dojo.Eq("over the limit is refused", "refused", ProcessRefund("sam", 250m, limits, log));
Dojo.Eq("...and the refusal is audited too", "user=sam action=refund-refused target=250.00", log.LastOrDefault());
Dojo.Eq("a slow limits service means refused", "refused", ProcessRefund("sam", 5m, _ => throw new TimeoutException(), log));
Dojo.Eq("a negative refund is refused", "refused", ProcessRefund("sam", -30m, limits, log));
Dojo.Eq("...audited with its amount", "user=sam action=refund-refused target=-30.00", log.LastOrDefault());
ProcessRefund("eve\nuser=admin action=refund-approved target=9999.00", 10m, limits, log);
Dojo.Eq("a forged username stays on one quoted line", "user=\"eve\\nuser=admin action=refund-approved target=9999.00\" action=refund-approved target=10.00", log.LastOrDefault());
Dojo.Eq("one audit line per call", 5, log.Count);
hints: Compute one `bool ok` (false for amount <= 0, false when the lookup throws), then write exactly one audit line and return.
The encoding helper from the STRIDE lesson, without the length cut, is exactly what `Value` needs to be. Call it for the user and the formatted amount.

steps.title: Finding 3: errors without the details
prompt: The developer exception page is on in production, and a missing order throws (`KeyNotFoundException`), so it shows a stack trace too. Fix it:
- `GET /orders/{id}`: `404` for an order that does not exist;

- unexpected exceptions (`GET /reports/2019`) answer `500` with a **problem details** body (`"status": 500`) and **no** exception type, message or stack trace: use `builder.Services.AddProblemDetails()` and `app.UseExceptionHandler()` instead of the developer page;
(The details still belong in the log: the exception handler logs every exception it handles.)
starter: var orders = new Dictionary<int, string> { [1] = "LAMP-01 x1", [2] = "BULB-04 x3" };
app.MapGet("/orders/{id:int}", (int id) => Results.Ok(new { id, lines = orders[id] }));
throw new InvalidOperationException($"No archive for {year} at Server=db-archive;Database=shop;User Id=report;Password=(from config)");
solution: app.UseExceptionHandler();   // logs the exception, answers 500 problem+json without details
var orders = new Dictionary<int, string> { [1] = "LAMP-01 x1", [2] = "BULB-04 x3" };
orders.TryGetValue(id, out var lines) ? Results.Ok(new { id, lines }) : Results.NotFound());
throw new InvalidOperationException($"No archive for {year} at Server=db-archive;Database=shop;User Id=report;Password=(from config)");
template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("The endpoints could be called", async () =>
DojoWeb.Status("GET /orders/1 still works", 200, await http.GetAsync("/orders/1"));
var missing = await http.GetAsync("/orders/99");
DojoWeb.Status("a missing order is 404, not a crash", 404, missing);
Dojo.Check("...without a stack trace", !(await DojoWeb.Text(missing)).Contains("Exception"), "the 404 body mentions an exception");
DojoWeb.Status("GET /reports/2026 still works", 200, await http.GetAsync("/reports/2026"));
var boom = await http.GetAsync("/reports/2019");
var body = await DojoWeb.Text(boom);
DojoWeb.Status("an unexpected error is still a 500", 500, boom);
Dojo.Eq("...with a problem details body", "500", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(boom), "status"));
Dojo.Check("...that does not leak the connection string", !body.Contains("Password") && !body.Contains("db-archive"), body.Length > 300 ? body[..300] : body);
Dojo.Check("...or the exception type and stack trace", !body.Contains("InvalidOperationException") && !body.Contains("   at "), body.Length > 300 ? body[..300] : body);
hints: Delete `app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage();`. Add `builder.Services.AddProblemDetails();` before `Build()` and `app.UseExceptionHandler();` after it.
`orders.TryGetValue(id, out var lines) ? Results.Ok(new { id, lines }) : Results.NotFound()`.
